title: Trick or Neat: Adversarial Ambiguity and Language Model Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: The paper investigates a potential "yes-bias" (affirmative response bias) by evaluating language models using 6 different prompt templates with various binary word orders (e.g., yes/no, true/false, right/wrong). It measures whether models disproportionately generate affirmative responses when asked to identify if a sentence is ambiguous, regardless of the actual ground truth.
